name: canon-review
description: Say 'canon review': an on-demand, read-only review of every fleet commit since the last one against the operator's canon (the § Motto handles in kattakath/nix-config's CLAUDE.md, read live). TOWARD / NEUTRAL / AWAY per handle with diff evidence, the leak gates (client literals included, since it runs locally), and a deterministic ok/problem state plus a stable issue body for issue-keeper.
